tweet.text:
One of the most underrated improvements with Claude Fable 5.1 is the pricing of cached tokens.

Cache reads are now just $0.25 per million tokens, down from $1.00 with Fable 5. That's a massive 75% reduction, while the regular $10/M input and $50/M output pricing stays unchanged.

This matters especially for coding agents and other long-running agentic workloads, where huge parts of the context are reused again and again. Anthropic estimates Fable 5.1 will be around 25% cheaper for typical workloads, and up to 45% cheaper for highly agentic ones.
